Art. 2
Type of event:
the event is opened to athletes of u17 category.
Art. 3
Participation:
all participants must have valid license issued by cycling federation for 2026.
the event is opened to teams with minimum 3 and maximum 9 riders (year of born 2010-2011).
maximum number of riders is limited for 176 riders.
Regulation:
the race will be run according to the czech cycling regulations and this technical guide. the race
is ridden in partial (floating) closures traffic condition with the regulation at the intersections,
however, all participants must comply with the provisions of the Act on Traffic on Roads No.
361/2000 coll. and its later changes. each race participant participates at his own risk, the
organizer is not liable for damages incurred by participants or caused by them.
the organizer reserves the right to make necessary changes to the programme in case of
unforeseen circumstances. all race participants are obliged to respect the instructions of the
organizers, police and commissaires.
Art. 4
Team managers’ meeting:
Kyšice, náves 95, 330 01 Kyšice, 49°45’18.7”n 13°29’05.8”e
1 may 2026 (Friday) - 20.00
Safety briefing:
Kyšice, náves 95, 330 01 Kyšice, 49°45’18.7”n 13°29’05.8”e
2 may 2026 (saturday) – 08.30
Art. 5
Radio-tour:
race information will be broadcasted on frequency: 448.490 mhz. the radios will be available
during the rider’s confirmation at the race office. Everyone is responsible for its battery charging
and returns the radio after the race at the race office.
Art. 6
Neutral service vehicles:
organizer provides 2 neutral service cars.

Powered byRAce ReGUlAtions
Art. 7
Time limit and gear restriction:
stage time limit is set to 10%.
Check point - every lap rider crossing the finish line with more than 10 minutes on the head
(leaders) of the race will be eliminated (otl).
Gear check: u17 riders are restricted to a gear roll out of 7.63 metres.
Art. 8
Race classifications:
8.1. Individual general classification by time
the winner shall be the rider whose sum of times in the individual stages including the time
bonuses and the penalties will be the lowest.
Time bonuses will be awarded in stage finishes 10” - 6” - 4”.
in the event of a tie the placings obtained in each stage shall be added and, as a last resort, the
place obtained in the last stage ridden shall be taken into consideration.
The leader of individual general classification by time wears yellow jersey, it is required to wear
this jersey.
8.2. Points classification
The classification is calculated as the sum of points obtained in stage finishes and intermediate
sprints. The winner of this classification shall be the rider with the highest sum of points.
stage 1 - 2 intermediate sprints
stage 2 - 2 intermediate sprints
intermediate sprints are awarded 3, 2 and 1 point.
Stage finishes are awarded 15, 14, 13, 12, 11, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 and 1 point.
In the event of a tie in the general individual classification by points, the following criteria shall be
applied in order until the riders are separated:
1. number of stage wins;
2. number of wins in intermediate sprints counting for the general classification on points;
3. general individual classification by time.
The leader of points classification wears green jersey, it is required to wear this jersey.
8.3. Climber’s classification
The classification is calculated as the sum of points obtained in mountain premiums.
The winner of this classification shall be the rider with the highest sum of points.
stage 1 - 2 mountain premiums
stage 2 - 2 mountain premiums
mountain premiums are awarded 5, 3, 2 and 1 point.
In the event of a tie in the general individual climber’s classification, the following criteria shall be
applied in order until the riders are separated:
1. number of first places in the climbs;
2. general individual classification by time.
The leader of the climber’s classification wears a polka dot jersey, it is required to wear this jersey.
8.4. Best Young rider classification
The winner of this competition shall be the best first year-rider (born in 2011)
classified in the individual general classification by time. The leader of the young rider
classification wears white jersey, it is required to wear this jersey.
8.5. The priority of the distinctive jerseys
1. Leader of the general classification by time YELLOW jersey
2. Leader of the points competition GREEN jersey
3. Leader of the climber’s competition POLKA DOT jersey
4. Leader of the young rider competition WHITE jersey
Art. 9

Art. 10
Anti-doping control:
the uci’s anti-doping regulations will be applicable. the anti-doping control takes place at the
finish of each stage – Kyšice, Náves 95, 330 01 Kyšice. Anti-doping rooms will be marked.
Art. 11
Awards ceremony:
The ceremonies shall attend first 3 riders in the stage and the classifications leading riders.
The ceremony for first 3 riders in the stage will take place always within 15 minutes after their
finishing!!!
After the final stage the first 3 riders of the general classification, winners of the secondary
classifications and competitions shall attend this ceremony.
the prize money will be sent to the team’s bank account after the race.

Art. 12
Penalties:
In the case of offenses, the commissaires’ panel will proceed in accordance with the
czech cycling penalty scale.
Art. 13
riders presentation:
the sheets will be displayed 70 minutes before the start of the stage. riders shall be
required to sign on the starting sheet at least 10 minutes before the start time at the
assembly point.
Art. 14
Feeding and green zones signposting:
Feeding zones will be signposted with the panels start and end of the Feeding zone, exact place
will be communicated at the team managers’ meeting and in the itinerary.
